nom: Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Pore Refreshing Mask Mud Cream Hydrating Wash Off Pack

avis.texte: The Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Mask is an absolute gem for anyone looking to detoxify their skin while maintaining hydration. As someone with oily skin, I’m always on the lookout for products that purify without leaving my skin feeling stripped, and this mask delivers perfectly. The formula is enriched with red bean extract, which is known for its antioxidant properties. The texture is smooth with a gentle, grainy consistency—enough to provide light exfoliation but not so rough that it irritates. Applying it feels like a mini spa experience; the mask spreads easily and has a natural, earthy scent that’s soothing without being overwhelming. I left it on for about 10 minutes, during which it didn’t dry out uncomfortably like some clay masks do. Washing it off was easy, and I loved the slight scrubbing effect as I rinsed. The results were immediate—my skin felt clean, refreshed, and soft, with noticeably minimized pores around my T-zone. What I appreciate most is that, unlike many pore-focused masks, it didn’t leave my skin tight or dry. Instead, my face felt balanced, as if it had just hit the reset button. This mask is perfect for weekly use, especially if you’re dealing with congestion or dullness. The Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Mask combines tradition with modern skincare needs beautifully, making it a must-try for anyone seeking gentle yet effective pore care.

So this is our extremely oily skin. This is not for combination. Skin does not work that well on it. If your skin is oily due to make up, this is not the product for you. I use this to minimize my pores.. it works, wonders it leaves my skin, soft and moisturized without the oily shine that I normally have. It lasts for an extremely long amount of time for the size of the container. I am happy with the product. I have been using their products for a while. I am 38 years old and I have always had extremely oily skin. I didn’t buy this because of TikTok. I bought this because I was looking for something that would help remove oil. So I’ve read on some of the reviews people say that it smells bad. I think it smells like bean paste. It doesn’t really have a clay texture because I also have clay masks, and I can feel the difference at the texture. For me, it does not sting my face unlike when I do my clay mask with apple cider vinegar. I can feel that one tightening my face. This one is a soothing oil remover that I sometimes forget I have on my face. I can walk around my whole house with it on and wash it off after 10 minutes sometimes I leave it on longer cause like I said I forget that it’s there. I would recommend this every single time. I have my I would never recommend this for someone who has dry skin or normal skin cause this would probably dry you out so much that it would cause you to get more acne. So I will emphasize to definitely know your skin type.

This mask is amazing! The texture is smooth and lightweight, making it easy to apply and comfortable while it’s on the skin. It gives a refreshing, cooling feel and rinses off easily without leaving any residue. I have large pores and oily skin so cleaning out my pores after a long day is crucial to my skincare routine. After washing it off, my skin feels clean, soft, and noticeably less oily. It hydrates without being heavy, making it suitable for my oily skin. The scent is mild and pleasant too.

avis.titre: Worth the hype!!! Friendly for all skin types!!
avis.texte: One word. OBSESSED!!!!! I have combination skin, and I've never gotten an exfoliating mask that didn't make my face dry or peel my skin raw until this one! My skin feels soft and rejuvenated after using this product, and it doesn't overdo the scrubbing. It's extremely gentle and does an amazing job of getting those pesky blackheads off around the nose. Earases then almost instantly. Smell is also pleasant! Smells like bananas to me! Highly recommend!!!

Love this mask! Minimizes the look of pores and helps clear excess sebum/oil as well without drying out your skin. You don’t need a whole lot to cover your face either. Kind of smells like bananas which I like. My boyfriend and I both use it, have opposite skin types, and still both benefit from it! Would repurchase

I really love this mask! It feels wonderful on my skin and has a pleasant, refreshing scent. While I'm not sure I've noticed a dramatic difference in my skin yet, I genuinely enjoy using it. It leaves my skin feeling nice, and it's become a relaxing part of my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Awesome clay mask and good price
avis.texte: First off, the smell. It smells great, it doesn't smell like red bean paste in your mochi but it smells nice. It's easy to put on, it pulls out all of your oils. You don't need to use much The red bean pieces don't really exfoliate, they're more for presentation. The amount in the container is good. They do use a trick to make the container look bigger than it does but the floor of the container reaches all the way to the bottom. Frankly this is an effective product but I'd reserve my 5 stars for Skinfood Strawberry mask.
The texture and scent is wonderful. It is easy to use. Rinses away clean. Skin is left feeling refreshed.

avis.titre: BEAUTY OF JOSEON Red Bean Mask
avis.texte: A lovely, moisturising mask. Leaves skin lovely & soft, with no irritation. Good value for money, comes in a big pot and only a thin layer is needed. Highly Recommended ⭐️

avis.titre: Optimale Porenpflege: frisch, sanft und effektiv!
avis.texte: Die Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Maske ist für mich ein echtes Highlight in der Hautpflege. Die cremige Tonerde-Textur lässt sich leicht auftragen und kühlt die Haut angenehm. Perfekt für müde, gestresste Haut oder heiße Tage. Der Duft ist dezent und natürlich, kein künstliches Parfüm, was ich besonders schätze. Was mich wirklich überzeugt hat: Die Maske reinigt gründlich, ohne auszutrocknen. Meine Poren wirken nach der Anwendung sichtbar verfeinert, und die Haut fühlt sich weich und hydratisiert an, kein Spannungsgefühl, kein Brennen. Die roten Bohnenextrakte und pflanzlichen Inhaltsstoffe sorgen für ein sanftes Peeling und ein frisches Hautbild. Fazit: Diese Maske ist ein Must-have für alle, die Porenpflege lieben, aber keine aggressive Reinigung wollen. Sanft, wirksam und mit einem Hauch koreanischer Eleganz, ich bin begeistert!

First, I love this brand and use a bunch of their products. I can always count of BoJ to give me hydrated, glowing skin. This is such a great mask for my oily skin; it gives me a nice detox without drying me out. My skin feels clean and fresh, and less oily after this. I use it once a week. They even include a little spatula. This dries firm, but not rock hard like other clay masks so it’s easy to wash off. I also love a lot of the other products from BoJ, and they are part of my routine: ginseng oil cleanser, green tea cleanser, glow rice toner, honey glow mask, eye serum, glow deep serum, glow serum, and tinted sunscreen. Sometimes I order from here, Stylevana or pick it up at TJ. Either way, it’s always fair pricing for products that work.

avis.titre: Ideal para piel sensible, pero faltan instrucciones claras
avis.texte: La he utilizado en dos ocasiones y me ha encantado. Tengo la piel sensible y no he tenido ninguna reacción, lo cual siempre es un alivio con productos nuevos. Después de usarla, mi piel se siente suave, limpia y fresca. Además, el empaque es muy bonito, perfecto incluso para regalar. Mi única queja es que el envase no tiene instrucciones, ni en inglés ni en español, así que si botas la caja original, te toca buscar online cómo usarla correctamente. Fuera de eso, es una excelente opción si buscas una mascarilla suave pero efectiva.

So far after only one use, I really enjoy the mask. I can’t speak to its exfoliating properties because I haven’t been using it long enough, but I can speak to the immediate effects. My skin is super sensitive. If you poke my skin, it will turn red and splotchy. A lot of clay/exfoliating masks will burn as soon as it touches my skin. I read another review saying this mask made their skin burn, so I was just expecting the same to happen for me, but it didn’t! No burning or tingling at all, and the grains are very very soft and not scratchy at all. I was expecting it to be a lot like the Glow Recipe hyaluronic clay mask, which burned the crap out of my face, so much so that my eyes watered. It is nothing like that mask, and it’s very soothing if anything. The grains/granules are soft but also hard enough to get the feeling of a physical exfoliator. It also doesn’t dry down and get itchy or cracky like a typical clay mask. It also smells like bananas to me lol I love my first experience and I can’t wait to use it more often and see results from the exfoliation!

I really like this mask! The texture is smooth and easy to apply, and it feels very refreshing on the skin. After rinsing, my face feels clean, soft, and less oily without being dry. It helps to minimize the look of pores and leaves a healthy glow. The jar is also generous in size, so it lasts for many uses. A great option for a self-care routine

avis.titre: Gentle Feel, Awaiting Visible Results on Dry Skin
avis.texte: I've been using the Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Pore Refreshing Mask (Mud Cream Hydrating Wash Off Pack) for about 3-4 times now. As someone with dry skin, I was looking for a mask that would be hydrating while also addressing my concerns about large pores. After washing it off, my skin does feel quite good – it's soft and refreshed, which is a definite plus. However, in terms of visible changes to my skin's overall appearance or a reduction in the size of my large pores, I haven't noticed significant results yet. Given that I've only used it a few times, I'm planning to continue using this mask for a few more months to give it a fair chance to see if there are any long-term benefits. It's a pleasant experience to use, but the jury is still out on its efficacy for my specific concerns.

El producto llegó en su caja, sellado y en buen estado. Viene el frasco lleno a diferencia de otros productos este esta super lleno y además no necesitas tanta cantidad para aplicar tu mascarilla asi que probablemente dure un montón, soy nueva usando este producto asi que luego les diré como me fue

Though the product is wonderful and I highly recommend it, I happened to dig through more of the product and saw something white poking through, I pulled it out hoping it wasn’t something weird because it had a rubber texture, but it was just a piece of a torn glove lol, at least I assume so, it’s the only reasonable explanation .😭
Really nice on the skin. My skin feels soft and renewed after using it. It’s like a spa day at home. I don’t like the scent of it because I have very sensitive skin.

This is my second mask our purchased from this brand. First off, the consistency is like myself; thick like butter 🤣 I’m serious yall. I love the scent which is a mild sweet scent but yall the wash off *chef kiss* soft and hydrated skin. Definitely value for your money.

I use twice a week and have seen results in smoother skin, my pores reduced after doing daily skin care routine. Red Bean refreshing pore mask gives my skin the right exfoliation. I pamper myself religiously at least once a week along with intensive gold eye gel patches

I'm obsessed with this product! The hydrating wash-off pack gently exfoliates and cleanses my pores, leaving my skin looking radiant and feeling soft. Definitely a new favorite!

I just want to say that this is a miracle face mask, it deeply cleans your pores and leaves your face hydrated, not to mention the amazing smell that this face mask has, no words to explain how good this smells.

I purchased this pore mask because I had seen it on TikTok which said it is great for oily skin, so I had to purchase it because I wear makeup often and I needed a product that with unclog my pores. I used this mask last night and as soon as I put it on my skin it was burning. The smell was also unpleasant, the smell of play dough. Se siente muy suave en la piel y la deja muy radiante, solo se usa una vez por semana y se nota el cambio.

Wonderful mask, does amazing things for the skin, gives it a clean youthful glow. I recommend 👌

This product was delivered almost empty and the outside was a bit dirty. There were also finger dents in the remaining mask left in there, so I’m guessing that means I was sent a product that had been used already🤮🥵
I received a used item. I’m very disappointed and definitely returning! What a waste of time!

Okay I got really excited and steamed my face before trying but don’t do this, the box said it’s supposed to be put on a dry face lol. Nothing terrible happened, my face feels super smooth and refreshing after using. I didn’t like how small the tool was though. It smells sooooo good, easy to apply and doesn’t leave a weird residue and I LOVE how big the jar is.

avis.titre: Skin softening with red bean paste!
avis.texte: It arrived fully sealed… both box and jar. It comes with a little plastic applicator to avoid contaminating with the oils in your fingers. It doesn’t have any particular fragrance inside the jar, but when applied to the face, it definitely has the scent of red bean paste. It’s a subtle scent, and quite pleasing. Just like any mask, you apply it after washing and drying your face, leaving it on for 10-15 minutes. I left it on for 15 minutes and then washed it off with warm water. Usually, I would follow with toner, serum and moisturizer, but I purposely did nothing else, just to be able to judge the softness and moisture quality of my skin with this product. My skin feels very soft, smooth, and fully moisturized. For the price, I think this is a very good product to buy. You don’t need a lot of it to cover your face. What you see in my photo that I scooped up is enough for the entire face. See my photo for a list of full ingredients.

I love a good mask. I love skincare. This is a great mask. It's easy to apply and rinse off and doesn't dry down and make your skin feel tight. I have dry skin and this works well for me. I love that it has exfoliant in it so when I apply it, I can rub it into my skin and exfoliate then leave it on for a while, rinse it off and my skin feels smooth and refreshed. The quantity of product in this jar is amazing. Usually you don't get much in these types of products but this one is packed full of product so it will last for a while. Overall, my experience has been great with this mask. The scent isn't strong at all and it leaves my skin looking and feeling beautiful. Dry skin approved!

Face mask arrives with outer box and a white plastic applicator to use in lieu of your fingers. It goes on smoothly and easily. I let sit about 20 mins and it didn’t dry hard and make my face feel taut like some masks do. It did dry up a bit compared to the texture it was when I put it on, just not rock solid. It could also be that I may have applied thicker than intended. At the end of the 20 mins it washed off easily with warm water. Left my face feeling smooth and refreshed. The product has little to no scent, which I consider a good thing as it can be difficult to have something sit on your face that is strongly scented or has a scent you simply don’t care for. Overall I really like this face mask.

For starters I appreciate the clean rating on Yuka for this specific product. I absolutely love this product. It’s soft and gentle while also getting the exfoliating job done. My skin always feels refreshed with a nice glow after using this product. The only downside is fighting the urge to taste it because it’s smooth yummy consistency and it smells so good! 10/10

Fruity scent similar to apple pure not really sure. It’s very subtle and the scent doesn’t bother me. At least doesn’t have the pungent odor of fermented beans. The mask made my skin so bright and smooth. It was easy to apply and wash off. Didn’t get any tingly sensation and I will continuing using. Glad the jar is big and price is fair I would repurchase. Tip: keep in the fridge to keep fresh after opening. Apply on clear skin leave for 15 min. Made in Korea

This mask has a nice thick & creamy texture. It looked like it would be gritty, but it is not! I applied using the small paddle it came with. Left it on for 15 minutes as directed. It felt nice & cool. It came off easily with a washcloth & warm water. My face feels very refreshed. Not sure how else to describe it. Not tight or oily, but moisturized & smooth. Would recommend.

This is by far my favorite mask. My face feels very rejuvenated and moisturized after its use. I have skin on the older side and needs more. It may not look beautiful but it smells very nice. Its relaxing and the smell is calming. My face fells better for it. Great product for my face. The jar is a good size and will last awhile.

The face mask is clearly natural, you can tell it is primarily the bean paste. But it smells like beans to me which was a bit off putting. The texture was not the greatest either. Following the directions, it did leave my skin soft and it was not irritating! It is nice to see a face mask with natural ingredients.
Haven’t opened yet but here are some pictures so you can see the size, looks like it’s good quality

texture: almost paste like with little micro bean pieces i’m assuming? quality: worth the money. i noticed a difference literally after first use and had to keep note so i can repurchase when i run out! washability: does not stain. i use a white clean skin disposable towel and the color never stays. application: comes with a spatula!! ALWAYS wash your face befure using a mask for maximum benefit and so it can do its job. NEVER use your hands to remove the product from the container. this causes cross contamination and puts bacteria in your mask 🫤 remember this with all products! easy to apply and easy to wash off. has a natural smell not a fragrance one. size: really good size container with reasonable amount of product for the price.

This is my second time using this mask. The first time I used it, I used the tiny spatula that came with it, and it doesn’t spread very easily, which is why I gave it 4 stars. The second time, I just used my fingers, and it went on so much easier! It looks like it would be really thick and pasty when it’s in the container, but it spreads on very creamy and smoothly. It washes off easily, and I continue my skincare routine. My skin feels refreshed, exfoliated, and overall much smoother. I will continue using, and will write another review as I continue using this mask.
I dont see much difference but skin stays soft after using it.
